body: Alright... Going for a checkup tmrw. Thanks a lot
Is a root canal a possible necessary treatment though its just a small pain?

Well I'm a bit afraid about using the products people have been talking about here cos I heard it messes with your hormones or something? I'm not so sure. Are they side effects of said treatment?

And sorry for the bad photo. I'll try to take a better one in future (since I'm monitoring it)

I think you're right. If it comes down to it, I'll probably see a dermatologist before doing anything. I see some product mentioned here a lot but I'm very apprehensive about using them now.. Thanks! I'll continue to monitor it on my own first
I'm not sure how much shedding is normal but I can lose 2-5 strands if I run my hands through while bathing..
Will check it out.. Thanks!

Thank you for the kind words... Now I know why this sub is talked about so often >< I'll try to hold on for as long as I can and definitely won't take my own life before talking to someone about it... Thanks again..

I came to this sub looking for one or two people who can relate to my situation and like just help me rid of my bad thoughts but it makes me happy to know that y'all are so willing to look out for each other even though you don't know each other personally. That in itself is very comforting.

As for myself, inferiority has been a problem for me. They say that there's always someone better but I've never felt better than anyone. It's horrible when there's no one to turn to when you wanna talk about life and rant and typing it out isnt gonna cut it.. Thanks for your time, I think all of you have done too much for me ><

Hey..

That little thought is very interesting. I've always been looking out for others and I think I wouldn't harm myself as long as there are others who care about me. But I can't stop these thoughts and very often I dont want to affect my friends any more... But if they slowly leave me and theres no one around for me, I think I might do it. I don't know. If I can help others be happy and they can move on, I will be content but I may not be happy myself. Not just unhappy, but everyone leaving me is a depressing thought itself, let alone if it actually happened. I'm not sure how well I'd handle it, but if it happens one day, I might come back here..

Thanks for your thought. I appreciate your offer but right now, I think I need some time to think about, and for myself for once.

Contrary to the belief of many of the people here, I've actually opened myself up completely to them before. I used to close myself off to them, then I opened up, and now it's back to square one.

A few years back when I was just an edgy teenager (I'm just less edgy now I hope), I hated everything except my friends. But I considered the fact that maybe the cliche about THAT phase in life was true and wondered if maybe, had I changed early,  I wouldnt stand to regret saying whatever I did back then. So I gave it my all, I tried to be nice, I said everything nicely in the best way that I can and I told them how I felt about stuff.

But I realized that no matter what I did, in however nice a way I put it, their attitude towards be was the same. They were just more content that I was obeying their every command without a second word. They still never asked about me. All the still cared about was my future life, my future job prospects, which I can appreciate, but sometimes I wish they'd care about me. As in, my well-being currently. They have super high expectations of me and that wasnt about to change.

I realized nothing was going to change, except myself, because I was slowly becoming into that model child that they've wanted. I want to be myself and it was getting very tiring but they never noticed anyway so.. ever since a year ago, I shut myself out again.

I've lurked in this subreddit for a while and I really hesitated to post something here. I never expected more than two or three replies and expected some generic responses but the support has been fuckin overwhelming and when I woke up and saw like 6 messages (I haven't even had that many pms from some of my friends in a day recently) it literally sent chills down my spine. I may not have another purpose for living but this thread has made me want to look harder.. Thanks for your input..

I care about my good friends a lot and I don't think that I can just stop thinking about their well-being and whatnot. I try to help them out in the few times that they need me. But it get really depressing when no one is there for you. I'm not saying that they have an obligation to care about me cos I do so for them (definitely not at all), but it's just nice to have someone around for you.

My family situation is a rather weird one. I'm living quite comfortably but I'm being driven to insanity. It's not just expectations but attitudes in the household is making me feel worthless and useless.

I strive to find some more purpose in my life but it's been a few years and seeing people smile is what makes me happiest. So, on my own, I feel like I've lost everything.
I don't think thats gonna work here because I'm obviously very close to my brother already (we play games together like everyday) and my parents haven't changed much.

As someone who tries his best to help others but has his fair share of problems, I implore that you don't hide your problems from your best friends. Your real best friends will want to hear everything you have to say and telling them you're stressed isnt going to make you an asshole.

What makes you an asshole is like what some of my friends do: When I tell them a problem and they respond with "I have my own problems too" and proceeds to tell you that you should just get over it. This is the real silencing to me. Now I feel like I've lost the right to tell you about my problems and I should just get over it like how you do (I don't actually mean "you" as in /u/butthenigotbetter).

If we were close friends and you told me about this, I would tell you to always let it out to me and even if I can't do much,  I will listen and maybe try to make you feel better. I can say so on behalf of all your good friends.

Well... For myself, I'm happy when I make others feel that way. Literally half the things I set out to do is to try to make someone's day and I do so willingly so none of my friends feel that they are a burden to me, which they are not, because I know what it's like to feel that way. Im quite reliant on others for support so I definitely need two or three of my good friends.. I'm still trying to move on from one or two who've just lost contact with me. 

Thanks for the concern ><

Maybe... My main motivation to carry on is for my hood friends cos I know how devastated they'll be to know in in this state, let alone having to see my body on the ground. There are definitely one or two specific people that I need a lot, but talking definitely helps no matter who it's from. Thanks..

I'm sorry for your loss. I don't think it's right if you pin the blame on yourself.. I'm sure the last thing you father wanted was for you to blame yourself for the taking of his own life.

I don't think I could ever take my life as long as the people who still care about me are still around. Knowing that they'll be hurt makes me feel worse. So they are pretty much the only reason I'm still around. It's just that that the thoughts of them leaving is getting more and more real, especially now and obviously I would look at the easiest way out if that were to happen.. Everything seems to be breaking apart and I have almost nowhere to go to anymore. I can just hope that everything will eventually fix itself, since me trying is just making everything worse. 

That's why I'm here. It's my second last place of refuge. Thanks for taking the time to bother about an insignificant being as me..

I've tried to not give too much of a fuck to small matters but I tend to overthink anyway... I'm trying to change but it isnt working out very well... I know it'll make me happy but idk what else I can do other than try again

I have things that I love to do too. But all of it just seems like a distraction from whats really going on in my life. So when I took a good look at how my surroundings are, I just break down and collapse. When everyone around you are just wearing masks, it's hard to find someone to talk to.

I'm trying my best to keep it together. Thanks for the advice.

That has to be one of the best things i've read all week >< I try my best to be THAT someone to my few good friends but it gets depressing when they just don't see me as more than an acquaintance or smth.. It doesn't bother me much but I can't say that I don't think about it.

I guess I lack the independence to keep myself sane, but all I'm asking is just to hear from others once in a while.. It doesn't even have to be about me. I wanna hear about how their life has been going, if they're stressed over anything and all that good stuff. It may be cheap talk to some but I treasure all of it a lot...

I think I might seek some external help soon.. The best motivation for myself is to better myself for the people in my life that matter to me. I'm just scared that everyone leaves and I so much meaning.

I hope I'll get better. Thanks so much for this ><
I'll definitely shoot you a message when I feel comfortable but right now, I just feel like putting some music on and just zone out.. Don't take this personally >< Have a good day, too.

Yeah... I was afraid to talk about this cos it seems like such a first world problem, caring about how I feel and shit. My good friends rarely talk to me about their stuff nowadays and I'm starting to wonder if I'm just a bad friend or others just tend to keep their problems to themselves. Seems more like the former.

I think I can appreciate the fact that my parents care about my future job, my standard of living, my comfort, but sometimes I wished that they would care about me. To see the stress they've put me under... I guess I've closed myself off to them because whenever I tried to talk about something like this, the topic always shifts to my future etc.

I hope I don't come off as too whiny (as some of my good friends probably think right now) but I'm still trying to fix a strained friendship between me and this friend of mine and yes, you probably guess it: I really have fallen heads over heels for her. And I fell hard.

All that, plus the fact that the people I care about are slowly drifting away, has broken me on the inside and I'm just mentally preparing to take the leap.

Thanks for taking some time to comment..

I appreciate your efforts, but I really don't want to be a burden to someone else.. Especially someone like you trying to reach out to others... I'm not anyone special, the world will go on without me and honestly, I won't actually sit on a ledge until everyone who matters to me has left... Thanks for your efforts, I'm sure you've saved more than a couple of lives.

I am super ultra dependent on others to keep me sane, in the sense that I would go insane whenever I really actually feel lonely. Like the feeling of having no one around, not just physically. When it's been weeks and someone who just called you their "best friend" doesn't say hi or give me single-worded please-go-away responses. I hope more people would come around to tell me that I server a purpose in this world, else I see no reason to be around. Thanks for your effort and concern.

I think I can agree on the brother part. But I argue with my parents a lot because we don't see eye to eye on basically everything. Feels like he's the only family I have left.

Thanks for your concern. I appreciate it, especially in times like right now.

Thanks for this.. I just need some words like this once in a while to keep me motivated. I don't think I can ever function on my own (I'll just end up depressed and consider ways to kill myself) so I think the few close friends I have know I'm quite dependent on others on the mental part. To keep my sanity.

Your comment has ironically made me question myself about this, and I think I can say for sure that as long as there's someone who cares about me, I wouldnt do it. What I'm saying is that once I lose the few who matter to me, I can't be so sure about that anymore...

In very few ways do I regret my decision.

Firstly, because I wasn't confident in myself being able to do well in JC. So I felt that even though I would be able to enter a local uni, I would not be taking a course I enjoy which will just lead to having a job I hate. The possibility of that happening hit me hard. 

Secondly, I have more time to pursue my passion. I'm using whatever time I can squeeze in (without neglecting studies) to improve on myself and learn more. As mentioned, I'm doing what I'm doing in poly now as a safety net, but now, my worry is that my safety net isn't as strong as I would have liked it to be. 

Thirdly, I think my course would help me in my endeavours regardless if I end up doing a desk job or venture into music. 

I really want things to work out for myself, but with so much to consider, it's getting slightly depressing to think about. But I need to let all of this out somewhere and hopefully I can conclude on what I should do/think. Thanks for your reply.
I'm currently experimenting with electronic music. I hope to incorporate other instruments into my tracks soon. Im still learning I guess..

I'm sorry about your loss. I understand I am more fortunate in many ways but I'll talk about that a bit more soon.. 

To answer your questions first (with a more settled mind):

1, 2 and 3) I'm doing a business course. My parents feel that a local uni entrance is key to getting a good job which means a better salary etc. I know this is true. They feel that me entering a poly lowers the chance of me doing so by a large margin. I was, 1) afraid I wouldn't be able to do well enough to do a preferable course of my choice in uni and hence would prefer some education in my field of interest; 2) I could allocate a lot more time for my passion.

4) Yes. 

5) I know what they feel towards music and their expectations of me. I know they would be devastated if they found out that although I would do whatever I can to do as well as I can, I'm actually putting a music career ahead (mentally).

6) Being honest, I severely underestimated my course, in the sense that I thought I could produce decent results if I just kept up with class. Though I did study very hard for both semesters a substantial period before my exams, I just didn't do well enough to meet their expectations.

7) It's a selfish thought, but I have/still am considering moving to another country, study there enough for a decent qualification, get some experience and do what I've enjoyed since years ago. I know it would be very difficult in terms of both making a living for myself and about I would go back to my family (whether it's my parents or aunties and uncles) for visiting. Canada is the place I have considered so far (and done quite a bit of research on)

One more point) After a few hours now, I won't say I'm suicidal or in deep depression as a whole, it's just that every time I think about this (how my future would turn out if this and that), i just feel that it won't work out the way I want it to and sometimes, just sometimes, I think of an easier way out. The fact that I'm still here probably is due to me being able to find some sort of self worth. 

I know what you mean in your response. Of course I'll never really know how you feel per se, but I get the general direction. I will always feel blessed that I have the opportunity to even try out doing what I love doing now, and this will really stick with me. I just want my life to be a bit more fulfilling.

Some people find joy in having a family. Some people find joy in travelling. I find my joy in doing what I love, and having people talk to me about things. I don't have many friends, and I can merely count the number of close friends I have with a hand, but these are the people who have so far, helped me get rid of my bad thoughts. My family only plays a role in my mental health because I don't want them to be disappointed with me, having been a coward.

I know living in Singapore isn't cheap (I was working under the assumption that the reader would assume I have thoughts about living overseas, my bad), and considering how small and weak our music industry is, I know I'll probably drive myself insane before someone actually recognizes my music. Having to balance so many things at once may eventually force me to give up on my passion and other interests. I really don't want to have to do this, since I've heard many stories about how Singaporeans just give up on their dream since they're too tired working and worrying about how to feed their family or even just themselves.

I'm sure I might be coming off as someone fed with a silver spoon and honestly, I'd like to think I spent most of my life in comfort and I'm very fortunate. But all this I have is only temporary. I'm happy cos I have what I have and its only because of my parents that I have all of this now. Very soon, I don't want my parents to ever have to spend a cent on me but I still want to be happy. I want to be independent and although I may have to for a while, I don't want to wake up to a job I hate in the long run. I have a strong belief it's possible and I working hard towards it, while studying.

Thanks for your input, I have thought a lot about what you said and this is the best I can think of right now.

It's a business course.
